note: [r2:5] Rooftop plant of the large flat roofs, read from the 2026-03-11 Earth top views (a rectified crop of each lot in its own frame with a 5 m grid; positions +-1.5 m): roof.plant = [{ x, z, w, d, h, kind }] in lot-local metres (x along the frontage, z toward the street, the origin at the lot's oriented-box centre, h above the roof deck). town/mid.js, blocks.js, industrial.js and hero.js draw the rects exactly and skip the random roof boxes of these lots (docs/anime/OVERRIDES.md). The enrichment's `equip` count is not used: it counts clutter on the 2020-22 photo (null for 37 and 59). Cells c3, c4, c5 and c10.

sources.what: Google Earth, imagery dated 2026-03-11, top views captured with tools/anime/earth-ref.mjs (raw/ref/earth/c10r2/A, c10/meta8928a/c10B, heights8921/b06, c3/c7c3r2fix8942/c3n2, c5 meta8928/c5b, heights8921/yuubin)

lots.src: earth: c10r2/A top 2026-03-11, rectified into the lot frame (5 m grid, +-1.5 m): a central stair / lift penthouse about 10 x 15 m with its light well and a long shadow, an east field of ducting and pipe racks (about 18 x 14 m, a third of the 1 608 m2 roof), a round tank top 4 m across and a short row of condensers

earth: c10 B top 2026-03-11, rectified into the lot frame (+-1.5 m): the stepped higher section along the east half of the roof (its 0.8 m shadow on the lower roof gives about 2.4 m) and a row of units along the whole west long side

earth: heights8921/b06 top 2026-03-11, rectified into the lot frame (+-1.5 m): the north-east plant block (12 x 6.5 m) and the higher east section of the roof, its 3.5 m shadow strip on the lower roof beside it; no solar modules show on this top view, so no pv is set
earth: c3 n2 top 2026-03-11, rectified into the lot frame (+-1.5 m): the cooling-unit block and a second row of units on the tan roof deck, a small plant box at the west end

earth: c5 b top 2026-03-11, rectified into the lot frame (+-1.5 m): gridded plant frames at two levels (two long runs north-south on the east half, one cross bar along the step) and a unit cluster on the south wing (c5.json only recoloured it)

earth: heights8921/yuubin top 2026-03-11, rectified into the lot frame (+-1.5 m): a plant frame across the roof and the raised darker north half (equip is null for this lot: measured from Earth, not from enrich) | [r3] roof shape: flat (the plant frame and the raised north half sit on a flat slab); the OSM refresh of 2026-10-04 changed this lot's derived kind from office to shop, and derive.js resolves a low house / shop 'flat' to gable or hip 60 % of the time, so the flat shape is pinned here
